# Blink Dog (`monsters:blink-dog`)
*Medium fey, lawful good* | **CR** 1/4 (XP 50; PB +2)
**AC** 13 | **HP** 22 (4d8 + 4) | **Speed** 40 ft.
**STR** 12 (+1) | **DEX** 17 (+3) | **CON** 12 (+1) | **INT** 10 (+0) | **WIS** 13 (+1) | **CHA** 11 (+0)
**Skills:** [Skill: Perception](../proficiencies/skill-perception.md) +5, [Skill: Stealth](../proficiencies/skill-stealth.md) +5
**Senses:** Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 15
**Languages:** Blink Dog; understands Elvish and Sylvan but can’t speak them

## Actions
- **Bite.** Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage.

## Bonus Actions
- **Teleport (Recharge 4+ (1d6)).** The dog teleports up to 40 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.
